conclusions.text: W36 first real data — now tracking BOTH apps (51Talk English + 51Talk Adults/Arabic) across App Store + Google Play in all 3 markets: 12 rating cells + Google Trends + cross-market reviews.

Ratings are solid but uneven. The Arabic 'Adults' app rates higher everywhere (App Store 4.6–4.9). The flagship English app is strong on App Store (KSA 4.31★, 14.0k ratings) but weaker on Google Play — especially KSA at 3.70. Android/English in KSA is the weakest cell and deserves a review-theme deep-dive.

KSA/UAE sentiment blind spot is solved: Apple's public feed returns no KSA/UAE reviews, but Google Play + the Adults app now give us reviews in all three markets. Early read is mostly positive, with a UAE payment complaint ('لم ادخل كلها بفلوس' ≈ couldn't get in, it's all paid) worth noting.
Google Trends (RELATIVE index; keyword '51Talk'): KSA highest (~20, softening), UAE ~14, Kuwait ~0 — directional only.

Owned social (Section B) now has first partial public data: Snapchat is by far the largest owned channel (~89.9K subscribers), YouTube ~2.08K, Pinterest ~0. 8 of 11 accounts (TikTok/Instagram/X/Facebook/Threads) can't be read publicly — pending platform access/keys (next stage).
Still blocking: competitor list (Patrick); backend social access/keys for engagement metrics (Norah); and confirming whether Kuwait/UAE have their own accounts (they look MENA-regional).

hypotheses.observation: Flagship English app rates lower on Google Play than App Store, especially KSA (3.70 vs 4.31).
hypotheses.hypothesis: Possible Android-specific friction (device/performance/payment) or a different user mix. Needs review-theme analysis to confirm — not a fact yet.

hypotheses.observation: Adults (Arabic) app rates higher than the flagship in every market.
hypotheses.hypothesis: May reflect a smaller, self-selected paying base rather than a genuinely better experience — not a like-for-like comparison.
